name: type5-fill-bit-set-and-empty-destination
source: gpsd test/sample.aivdm (BSD-2-Clause), sentences at lines 1017 and 1018 (fragments of sequential id 2 on channel A, joined in order)
reference: Destination all @ decodes to the empty string, present (ruling 6 of 0.14). Ship name 'HEALTH CONTROL 13' + 3 spaces, trimmed. ETA hour 24 and minute 60 are the not-available codes. gpsd: destination "", eta 00-00T24:60Z, draught 2.0. Expect differs from input: the ship name's trailing spaces come back as @, and the last character '2' (000010) has bit 424 set, a fill bit past L = 424, which decode ignores (ruling 2 of 0.14) and encode writes as zero.
